title: Further Gauss-elimination / row-rank examples
summary: Further consistency problems by row-rank reduction; an infinite-solution non-homogeneous system, a homogeneous family, and a four-variable system.
transcription_policy: Notebook order and mathematical meaning are preserved, while physical page boundaries are not used to split worked examples. Each problem is rendered once as a complete accordion with the full question visible and the complete verified solution inside. Where class working is incomplete or arithmetically unreliable, PankusDesk completion/verification is labelled explicitly.

Thus \(\rho(A)=\rho(A|B)=2<3\), so the system is consistent with infinitely many solutions.
